news.title: How UNI uses data to strengthen student retention and success
news.summary_en: The University of Northern Iowa has been featured by the Institute for Higher Education Policy (IHEP) in its Postsecondary Data for Action Network Spotlight series, recognizing the university’s use of data to strengthen student retention and success.

news.title: From UNI to the Smithsonian: Finding a place in the museum world
news.summary_en: A summer internship at the Smithsonian's National Museum of American History is giving UNI history graduate Ivana Ebersole a behind-the-scenes look at one of the world's leading museums while helping her discover where she fits in the museum profession.
